items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: He said, Cosmo got some money, Dave Bithalemus got some money.

ctx.x: And the guy said, man, I know you.

And then I told him, he said, oh, yeah. And then he said, let me tell you something. He said, did you ever get any money out of this Tra-La-La deal? I said, hey, what kind of money? He said, oh, some money was paid off. He said, I know it. He said, Cosmo got some money, Dave Bithalemus got some money. He said, and I was out on the road selling your record. He said, and it was selling. He said, but all of a sudden, I had to drop your record. He said, I came back in raising hell, and they gave me some money to shut…
